hooks.command: [ -n "$TMUX" ] && { s=$(tmux display -p -t "$TMUX_PANE" '#S'); w=$(tmux display -p -t "$TMUX_PANE" '#I'); a=$(tmux display -p -t "$TMUX_PANE" '#{window_active}'); rm -f "/tmp/tmux-claude-seen-$s-$w"; [ "$a" = "1" ] || printf '#[fg=colour208,bold]' > "/tmp/tmux-claude-$s-$w"; }; exit 0

[ -n "$TMUX" ] && { s=$(tmux display -p -t "$TMUX_PANE" '#S'); w=$(tmux display -p -t "$TMUX_PANE" '#I'); a=$(tmux display -p -t "$TMUX_PANE" '#{window_active}'); [ "$a" = "1" ] || [ -e "/tmp/tmux-claude-seen-$s-$w" ] || printf '#[fg=green,bold]' > "/tmp/tmux-claude-$s-$w"; }; exit 0
{ printf '\a' > /dev/tty; } 2>/dev/null; [ -n "$TMUX" ] && { s=$(tmux display -p -t "$TMUX_PANE" '#S'); w=$(tmux display -p -t "$TMUX_PANE" '#I'); : > "/tmp/tmux-claude-$s-$w"; }; exit 0
